entry.title: Undercrown 10 Coronets — Tin of 10
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, cola or dark rum (projected)
Occasion: Quick rich smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, cacao, earth, espresso, dried cherry and raisin sweetness give Undercrown 10 its darker and more concentrated anniversary profile. Mexican San Andrés over Connecticut Broadleaf and Nicaraguan filler should translate particularly well to the compact Coronet format, emphasizing pepper, cocoa and dark fruit while retaining the blend's characteristic richness. Untasted here, so Strength 8 and Quality 8 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut currently lists the exact Undercrown 10 Coronets from A$119 with purchasable package options. No Australian single of the exact Coronet has been verified. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
